selection.policy: lemma measured=valid 75th-percentile duration; flowing=valid 25th-percentile duration from a different reader (0.20-4.00 s quality window); short-surah=one aligned clip per QAC word; labels are operational and not canonical qiraat classes
selection.knownMappingException: QAC 109:1 word 2 joins ya+ayyuha; Tadabur alignment words 2 and 3 are merged into one clip.
selection.shortSurahAlignment: Publisher spans are used directly; spans over 4.00 s are capped from their published start. Invalid/excess source-duration spans at 106:2:3-4 are re-anchored from local Whisper and audio-end evidence.
